focus_tree = {
	id = lr_amc_focus

	country = {
		factor = 0
		modifier = {
			add = 10
			tag = AMC
		}
	}

	default = no
	continuous_focus_position = { x = 50 y = 1400 }
	initial_show_position = {
		focus = LR_AMC_council
	}

	focus = {
		id = LR_AMC_council
		icon = GFX_goal_generic_national_unity
		x = 6
		y = 0
